claims.explanation: Deforolimus is an allosteric mTORC1 inhibitor, so sensitivity is expected in tumors whose growth depends on mTORC1-driven translation and survival signaling. The strongest genomic predictors are activation of the PI3K/AKT/mTOR axis (PIK3CA mutation/amplification, PTEN loss, AKT or MTOR activation) and possibly loss of negative regulators such as STK11, whereas RAS/RAF-driven tumors with intact PTEN may be less dependent on mTORC1 and therefore relatively resistant.

features.basis: PTEN loss activates PI3K/AKT/mTOR; enriched in sensitive lines (ZR751, SF295, SF126, OVK18, MFE319) and literature links PTEN loss to mTOR dependence.
PIK3CA mutation activates PI3K/AKT/mTOR; seen in sensitive lines (RT112, HCC1954, HGC27, MFE319) and supported by pathway literature.
MTOR pathway alterations are reported in cancers and may increase dependence on mTORC1; MFE319 (sensitive) carries an MTOR mutation.
STK11/LKB1 loss can relieve AMPK-mediated mTORC1 inhibition; observed in sensitive lines (NCIH1623, PLCPRF5, G361) and mechanistically plausible.
NF1 loss activates RAS/MAPK and may increase mTORC1 signaling; seen in sensitive lines (RT112, PLCPRF5) but also in some resistant lines, so weaker.
AKT overexpression is a reported mTOR pathway alteration and would predict mTORC1 dependence.
S6K1 overexpression is a reported mTOR pathway alteration and may indicate active mTORC1 signaling.
4EBP1 overexpression is a reported mTOR pathway alteration and may reflect mTORC1-driven translation.
eIF4E overexpression is a reported mTOR pathway alteration and may increase dependence on mTORC1-mediated translation.
KRAS-mutant lines are enriched among least affected (GSU, SNU81, TCCPAN2, T3M4, SW1573), suggesting RAS-driven tumors may bypass mTORC1 dependence.
BRAF-mutant lines appear in both sensitive and resistant groups (e.g., UACC62 resistant), so MAPK-driven tumors may not require mTORC1; weak evidence.
TP53 mutation is common in both sensitive and resistant lines, so it is not a strong predictor; included only as a weak negative feature.
